text:
Rasmus L: RFC merged for new log envelope + region-aware sampling. Short gist: we will add top-level envelope fields (env, cluster, gpu_type, shard) and a sampling policy that can be configured per region+instance class. See config snippet below. Please review, esp security and SRE.

Anita K: Do we have guidance on PII in the envelope? user_id / account_id handling?

security-bot: Policy: always pseudonymize user identifiers before leaving node. Use deterministic HMAC with team-managed salt; keyed at KMS. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/logging-pii

Mike R: How will this affect Grafana dashboards? We'll lose cardinality if user_id hashed, but okay. Need to ensure metrics still join by session_id when present.

Tina S: Concern: decreased sampling in eu-west caused missing infrequent GPU OOM alerts last week. We should have a safety sampling floor for errors and SLO-breach tags.

Rasmus L: Agreed. Proposal: keep error-level logs at 100% globally; sample info/debug by policy. Also add deterministic 'trace_key' so we can join events without raw IDs. Draft rule:
```
envelope: {
  service: string,
  cluster: string,
  region: string,
  gpu_tier: string,
  trace_key: hmac(user_id)
}
sampling_rules:
  - match: region=="eu-west" && gpu_tier=="a100"
    rate: 0.05
  - match: level=="error"
    rate: 1.0
```

infra-bot: Canary rollout started in us-west-2 and eu-west-1; 12% of nodes. 2k logs/min -> 220r/s processed -> estimated cost delta +4%.

Anita K: On HMAC salt rotation — make sure old trace_keys can be rekeyed in-store for forensics. We need a migration plan.

Rasmus L: Noted. I'll add key-rotation docs and an on-call playbook for when sampling misconfig spikes alerts (SRE + Security). Can reviewers ack when they skim this? :eyes:

Mike R: ack

Tina S: ack

security-bot: automated scan: no PII fields detected in the example.
